specification.problem: Evaluate a balanced binary NAND formula (depth 2, N=4 leaves, explicit classical input x) via a discrete-time quantum walk whose phase is compiled from x. The scoped instance is the balanced depth-2 tree only, NAND(NAND(x1,x2),NAND(x3,x4)).
specification.reconstruction_scope: Build a fixed unitary U=R_graph*O_x on a small tree-graph walk space for the balanced depth-2 instance, with x compiled into gates. The O(sqrt N) scaling is not certified, and no black-box query complexity is claimed. The general-formula bound N^{1/2+O(1/sqrt(log N))} is out of scope. The decoding threshold, the walk and reflection details, and the exact attachment of the tail are not derived from the abstract.

symbols.domain: positive integer, N=4 for the instance

symbols.meaning: unitary compiled from known x that marks leaf edges
fixed reflection or diffusion on each vertex star

symbols.domain: basis state of the position register

equations.label: Formula for the instance
equations.description: Depth-2 balanced NAND tree on 4 leaves, written with NAND(a,b)=not(a and b).
equations.justification: The abstract names balanced binary NAND formulas; the depth-2 case is a chosen smallest instance.

equations.label: Walk step
equations.description: One discrete walk step: the x-dependent oracle followed by a fixed reflection.
equations.justification: Taken from the method sketch. This is a proposed construction, not stated in the abstract.
assumptions: x is compiled classically into gates
the exact form of R_graph is not specified

equations.label: Evolved state
equations.description: State after T steps from the root-edge initial state.
equations.abstract_quote: O(√N) discrete query quantum algorithm for evaluating balanced binary NAND formulas
equations.justification: The abstract's O(sqrt N) query claim suggests T=O(sqrt N) walk steps, each using one query-like O_x.

equations.label: Readout statistic
equations.description: Overlap with the initial state, compared to a threshold. By the sketch, a value near 1 (reflection) corresponds to f=1 and a value near 0 (transmission) to f=0.
equations.justification: Taken from the method sketch. The threshold and the walk details are unverified.
assumptions: threshold to be calibrated by simulation

registers.name: pos
registers.size: ceil(log2 V) qubits, V=vertex or edge count (about 8 for the tree plus tail)
registers.role: position over tree vertices, leaf edges, and the root tail

registers.name: coin
registers.role: edge or direction register within a vertex star

specification.initial_state: |r> on pos, the root-edge/tail vertex, with coin in |0>

steps.description: Apply O_x, compiled from the known x, to attach leaf edges with x_i=1 and detach those with x_i=0.
Apply the fixed star reflection R_graph. Repeat for T steps.
Compute the root overlap p and compare with a threshold to decode f(x).

specification.measurement: Measure (or classically compute, in simulation) the probability of the root-edge state; no measurement is included in the unitary itself.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Threshold p to output f(x). The threshold value is not specified.
assumptions: Scope is limited to depth-2 balanced N=4
x is compiled into gates, so no black-box query complexity is claimed
the encoding of vertices into pos and coin is a free choice
missing_information: Exact walk graph, weights and coin operators
The correct reflection operators and phase-estimation details
Threshold and T for the instance
